messages.author: dirk.carlsen.100834@mailhaven.example
messages.text: Glad to see this host committee officially set up for Madison 2026. We have plenty of groundwork to lay out between now and next summer.

messages.author: iris.farrow.100371@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Thanks Baptiste. I have been looking at potential tour routes for the farm visits and need to sync with Elena soon on capacity limits.

messages.author: iveta.dahl.101420@lakemail.example
messages.text: Keep me in the loop on those farm stops Leonor. My crew can help sponsor the welcome reception if the budget permits.

messages.author: elena.chowdhury.101043@quillpost.example
messages.text: The events team reached out regarding registration flow for next year. I will draft our initial schedule by the end of the week.

messages.author: hector.guerrero.100463@emberleafinecheese.example
messages.text: Happy to travel down from Green Bay to assist with logistics once we get closer to the dates.

messages.author: dirk.carlsen.100834@mailhaven.example
messages.text: Now that we are past February, we need to nail down the volunteer shifts for the tasting floor.

messages.author: iris.farrow.100371@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Margaux Chowdhury and I mapped out the sign-up sheet. We will circulate it to the wider chapter next month.

messages.author: obi.kone.100216@birchmoorcreamery.example
messages.text: Just reviewed the traceability requirements for the on-site product displays. Everything looks straightforward and standard.

messages.author: dirk.carlsen.100834@mailhaven.example
messages.text: Everything is in place for the conference this week. Thanks to everyone for the steady work over the past year.

messages.author: iris.farrow.100371@bluebarn.example
messages.text: The event wrapped up wonderfully. I am archiving my notes now and closing this space out.
